pairs.target: yīwén lái wèn tǎ wéi yuànbuyuànyì pángtīng nàchǎng huì shí , xiān shuō yuè qín yě yào lái .
pairs.english: When Iven asked whether Tavi wanted to observe the meeting, he first said Yueqin would be there too.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文来问塔维愿不愿意旁听那场会时，先说月芹也要来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi zìjǐ tīngcuò . tāmen zuótiān cái zài fànzhuō shàng jiǎng guò shí zhuó , yīwén shuō fùqīn zǎoyǐ shōudào ruì shīfu jiāo de tínggōng biǎo , mǎtóu nàbiān běnlái jiùyào pài rén , bìng búshì tīng le zìjǐ yíjù huà cái línshí jiào rén .
pairs.english: Tavi thought he had misheard. They had only discussed Stonewash at dinner yesterday, but Iven said his father already had Master Rui’s stoppage sheet; the landing had planned to send someone, not because of something he had just said.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为自己听错。他们昨天才在饭桌上讲过石濯，伊文说父亲早已收到芮师傅交的停工表，码头那边本来就要派人，并不是听了自己一句话才临时叫人。

pairs.target: huì zài dìèrtiān kāi . tā ruò yuànyì , kěyǐ bāng zhe héduì dāngtiān bānzǒu dōngxī de cìxù , yǒurén wèn dào cái dá , búbì tì shuí jiǎng tiě yàng wèishénme biàn . ruì shīfu huì lái , jiù zhuāngzhì de shì yǒu tā shuōmíng .
pairs.english: The meeting was the next day. If he wished, he could help check the order things had been moved, answering when asked, without explaining why the iron changed. Master Rui would explain the old installation.
pairs.hanzi: 会在第二天开。他若愿意，可以帮着核对当天搬走东西的次序，有人问到才答，不必替谁讲铁样为什么变。芮师傅会来，旧装置的事有她说明。

pairs.target: " nà wǒ dài nǎ zhāng biǎo ? " " nǐ zìjǐ nà zhāng . búshì jiào nǐ bèi yìpiān . "
pairs.english: “Which sheet should I bring?” “Your own. You are not being asked to recite a speech.”
pairs.hanzi:
“那我带哪张表？”
“你自己那张。不是叫你背一篇。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuōwán , tíng le yíxià , wèn tā shìbushì bútàixiǎng qù . tǎ wéi shuō xiǎng , zhǐshì tóuyìhuí yǒurén qǐng tā qù tīng gōngqián zěnme suàn , búshì qǐng tā bāndōngxī .
pairs.english: Iven paused, then asked if he was reluctant. Tavi said he wanted to go; it was simply the first time anyone had invited him to hear how wages were calculated rather than to carry things.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说完，停了一下，问他是不是不太想去。塔维说想，只是头一回有人请他去听工钱怎么算，不是请他搬东西。

pairs.target: dào le kāihuì nàtiān , tā réng chuān sè lā bǔ hǎo de wàiyī . yīwén zhàn zài ménkǒu bào zhe liǎngzhāng tú , lǐng biān hěn zhěngqí , shǒu cè què zhān zhemò .
pairs.english: On meeting day he still wore Sela’s repaired coat. Iven stood at the doorway holding two maps, collar neat but ink on his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 到了开会那天，他仍穿瑟拉补好的外衣。伊文站在门口抱着两张图，领边很整齐，手侧却沾着墨。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng tì tā cā , fāxiànzìjǐ yě méiyǒu gānjìng bù , zhǐhǎo zhǐ gěi tā kàn . tā dītóu kàn yìyǎn , shuō děng yǒukōng , biàn xiān lǐng tǎ wéi jìnqù .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to wipe it but had no clean cloth either, so pointed it out. Iven glanced down, said later, and led him in.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想替他擦，发现自己也没有干净布，只好指给他看。他低头看一眼，说等有空，便先领塔维进去。

pairs.target: yuè qín zuòzài chuāng biān , jiǎoxià fàng zhe yìzhī xiǎobāo , zhèng tóngyígè chuān duǎnguà de nánrén bǐ huáchuán kàoàn de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Yueqin sat by the window with a small bag at her feet, showing a short-jacketed man where boats docked.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹坐在窗边，脚下放着一只小包，正同一个穿短褂的男人比划船靠岸的地方。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn tǎ wéi , xiān wèn zhèhuí yǒuméiyǒu dài wǎn . tā lèng le yíxià , tā shuō kāi zhèmejiǔ de huì , zǒnggāiyǒu rén qǐng fàn .
pairs.english: Seeing Tavi, she first asked if he had brought a bowl this time. He blinked; she said such a long meeting ought to come with someone buying lunch.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见塔维，先问这回有没有带碗。他愣了一下，她说开这么久的会，总该有人请饭。

pairs.target: wūlǐ zuò zhe qú gōng , zhuāngpèi de rén , háiyǒu jǐwèi tì gōngfáng shuōhuà de rén .
pairs.english: The room held canal workers, assembly staff and several works representatives.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里坐着渠工、装配的人，还有几位替工房说话的人。

pairs.target: liǔxiānshēng yě zài , réng shì tǎ wéi hěnzǎoyǐqián zài fēnshuǐ tái jiàn guò de nà fù jí yàng , xiān tóng yīwén fùqīn shuōwán yíduàn , cái xiǎngqǐ jiāng yǐzi wǎng lǐ ràng , gěi hòulái de rén téng wèizhì .
pairs.english: Mr Liu was there too, as hurried as when Tavi first saw him at the water-dividing terrace long ago; only after talking to Iven’s father did he remember to shift his chair for later arrivals.
pairs.hanzi: 柳先生也在，仍是塔维很早以前在分水台见过的那副急样，先同伊文父亲说完一段，才想起将椅子往里让，给后来的人腾位置。

alignment.english: shift his chair for later arrivals

pairs.target: zuìxiān zhēng de jìng búshì tōngzhī .
pairs.english: Surprisingly, the notice was not the first argument.
pairs.hanzi: 最先争的竟不是通知。

pairs.target: běi qú lái de gōngfáng dàibiǎo shuō , yǒu jǐ chí liào yídàn xià le shuǐ , jiù bùnéng xiǎng tíng jiù tíng , děng yícì huàidiào , sǔnshī de yě yǒu zuò gōngrén de qián .
pairs.english: The North Canal works representative said some vats could not be stopped at will once soaked; spoiled batches cost workers money too.
pairs.hanzi: 北渠来的工房代表说，有几池料一旦下了水，就不能想停就停，等一次坏掉，损失的也有做工人的钱。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěnkuài , ná yìdié jiāohuò qīngdān yā zài zhuōshàng , zhǐ jiǎo quánjuàn le .
pairs.english: He spoke fast, weighting a stack of delivery lists on the table, every corner curled.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得很快，拿一叠交货清单压在桌上，纸角全卷了。

pairs.target: yuè qín wèn , nà tā shǒulǐ bàntiān méi zhuāng chéng de yán dài , suànbusuàn yě zài gǎn rìzi . duìfāng shuō búshì búsuàn , shì shuí dōu wǎnghòu tuō bù qǐ , ruò shàngyóu zài yā shuǐ , dī chù jǐjiān gōngpéng yě dé xiān bān .
pairs.english: Yueqin asked whether her salt bags, left unloaded for half a day, had deadlines too. He said of course, but nobody could afford delay; if upstream held more water, the low workshops would have to evacuate first.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹问，那她手里半天没装成的盐袋，算不算也在赶日子。对方说不是不算，是谁都往后拖不起，若上游再压水，低处几间工棚也得先搬。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài hòumiàn , dìyīcì kànjiàn yìzhāng tú shàng nà jǐtiáo fēnkāi de xiàn , yuánlái zài wūlǐ huì jǐchéng zhèyàng .
pairs.english: Sitting at the back, Tavi saw for the first time how the map’s separate lines could crowd together in one room.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在后面，第一次看见一张图上那几条分开的线，原来在屋里会挤成这样。

pairs.target: liǔxiānshēng ná chǐ zhǐxiàng shàng zhá , shuō yǔyè línshí gǎi fàng bùnéng quán qǔxiāo , kě xiàmiàn de chuán yě bùnéng yǒngyuǎn píng tīngjiàn shuǐshēng cái zhīdào .
pairs.english: Mr Liu pointed his ruler at the upper sluice: emergency releases on rainy nights could not all be abolished, but the boats below could not forever learn only from the sound of water.
pairs.hanzi: 柳先生拿尺指向上闸，说雨夜临时改放不能全取消，可下面的船也不能永远凭听见水声才知道。

pairs.target: qú gōng shuō pài rén dāngrán néng pài , zhǐshì liǎngchù zhuǎnwān kànbújiàn qí , yèlǐ yòu bùnéng kàoqí , shuí lái fù duō pǎo de nàge rén .
pairs.english: The canal worker said a messenger was possible, but flags were invisible round two bends and useless at night; who would pay the extra runner?
pairs.hanzi: 渠工说派人当然能派，只是两处转弯看不见旗，夜里又不能靠旗，谁来付多跑的那个人。

pairs.target: yīwén fùqīn méiyǒu mǎshàng dāying . tā wèn xiànyǒu de liǎngchù gǎng néng bunéng lún zhe chuán , zài wèn ruò ràng sònghuò de rén shùndài , xiāoxī jiūjìng néng chí duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: Iven’s father did not agree at once. He asked whether the two existing posts could relay in turns, then how late a message might be if delivery workers carried it along.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文父亲没有马上答应。他问现有的两处岗能不能轮着传，再问若让送货的人顺带，消息究竟能迟多久。

pairs.target: yuè qín shuō shùndài jiùshì pái zài rénjiā de huó hòumiàn , shàng huí zhǐ dào le , shéng yǐjīng shītòu .
pairs.english: Yueqin said carrying it along meant putting it after somebody else’s work: last time the rope was soaked before the paper arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹说顺带就是排在人家的活后面，上回纸到了，绳已经湿透。

pairs.target: huà dào zhèlǐ , ruì shīfu qǐng tǎ wéi shuō nàtiān dōngxī xiānhòu zěnme bān . tā jiāng zìjǐ nà yíyè zhǎnkāi , shuō xiān tíng le xiǎo kuàng , hòulái kōngchuán cái nuó , děng shàng zhá de duǎn tiáo huílái , gōngrén yǐjīng shǎo zuò bàntiān .
pairs.english: At that, Master Rui asked Tavi to describe the carrying sequence. He opened his page: first the frames stopped, then the empty boats moved; by the time the upper sluice note came, workers had lost half a day.
pairs.hanzi: 话到这里，芮师傅请塔维说那天东西先后怎么搬。他将自己那一页展开，说先停了小框，后来空船才挪，等上闸的短条回来，工人已经少做半天。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tiān shuí gùyì dānwù , yě méi bǎ zìjǐ méi tīngjiàn dehuà còu jìnqù .
pairs.english: He added no accusations of deliberate delay and no words he had not heard.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有添谁故意耽误，也没把自己没听见的话凑进去。

pairs.target: gōngfáng dàibiǎo wèn tínggōng shìbushì yīnwèi tā jiǎng de tiě yàng . tǎ wéi shǒuzhǐ jǐn le yíxià , ruì shīfu yǐjīng jiēguò lái , shuō zǎoshàng shíjiē shī , shuǐwèi gāo , bānyùn xiān tíng , jiù péng cè yàng biànhuà zài fànhòu , shì liǎngjiànshì , bùnéng ná hòu yíjiàn mǒdiào qiánmiàn yǐjīng huādiào de shíjiān .
pairs.english: The works representative asked if the iron samples caused the stoppage. Tavi’s fingers tightened, but Master Rui answered: wet steps and high water stopped carrying in the morning; the old shed samples changed after lunch. Those were two events; the later one could not erase time already lost.
pairs.hanzi: 工房代表问停工是不是因为他讲的铁样。塔维手指紧了一下，芮师傅已经接过来，说早上石阶湿、水位高，搬运先停，旧棚测样变化在饭后，是两件事，不能拿后一件抹掉前面已经花掉的时间。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le piànkè . yīwén dītóu , zài zìjǐ chāo de nà yíliè pángbiān tiān le yìtiáo héngxiàn , jiāng liǎngduàn shíjiān fēnkāi .
pairs.english: The room fell quiet briefly. Iven looked down and added a horizontal line beside his copied column, separating the two periods.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了片刻。伊文低头，在自己抄的那一列旁边添了一条横线，将两段时间分开。

pairs.target: hòulái dìngxià de zhǐshì yíduàn shìxíng : zhè tiáo hé shàngxià liǎng gǎng gè liú yígè rén chuán gǎi fàng de xiāoxī , fèiyòng xiān cóng zhè duàn shuǐlù de rìchángzhīchū lǐ liè , yù jí yǔ bùnéng děng huíhuà cái fàng , dàn tōngzhī yào tóng fā , bùxǔ yā dào sòng wán huò zàishuō .
pairs.english: They agreed only a trial: one person at each of the river’s upper and lower posts would relay release changes, funded for now from routine waterway spending. Sudden rain could not wait for replies before release, but notices must go at the same time, never after deliveries.
pairs.hanzi: 后来定下的只是一段试行：这条河上下两岗各留一个人传改放的消息，费用先从这段水路的日常支出里列，遇急雨不能等回话才放，但通知要同发，不许压到送完货再说。

pairs.target: yuèdǐ zài kànhuāle duōshǎo , chí le duōshǎo , gōngfáng hé mǎtóu dōu yào ná jìlù lái .
pairs.english: At month’s end they would review spending and delays, both works and landing bringing records.
pairs.hanzi: 月底再看花了多少、迟了多少，工房和码头都要拿记录来。

pairs.target: yuè qín méiyǒu yīncǐ bǎ tínggōng de qián shōuhuí qù bù tí . nà yíxiàng háiyào hé rénshù hé shíduàn , tā jiāng ruì shīfu nà zhāng yǒu míngzì de biǎo lìng fàng yìbiān , shuō jīntiān zhìshǎo dé xiěmíng shì shuí shōuxià le , bié ràng rén míngtiān yòu cóngtóu jiǎng .
pairs.english: Yueqin did not drop the lost-work payment. Numbers and hours still needed checking; she set Master Rui’s named sheet aside, asking at least for the receiving person’s name today so nobody had to start again tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹没有因此把停工的钱收回去不提。那一项还要核人数和时段，她将芮师傅那张有名字的表另放一边，说今天至少得写明是谁收下了，别让人明天又从头讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng dé kǒu gān , děng sànhuì cái fāxiànzìjǐ de shuǐbēi yìzhí méi ná chūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi’s mouth dried as he listened; only after the meeting did he realize he had never taken out his cup.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听得口干，等散会才发现自己的水杯一直没拿出来。

pairs.target: yīwén zǒu guòlái , xiān wèn tā gāngcái nà yìháng shù shìbushì chāo cuò , zìjǐ bǎ zǎo tíng hé wǔhòu tíng hùn zài le yìqǐ . tā zhǐ gěi yīwén kàn , hòuzhě gǎi wán , chángcháng chū le yìkǒuqì , shuō yuánlái zìjǐ yě dé dài liǎngzhāng zhǐ cái zhuāng dé xià .
pairs.english: Iven came over and asked if he had copied one line wrong, confusing the morning and afternoon stoppages. Tavi showed him; after correcting it, Iven sighed deeply and said he too needed two sheets to fit it all.
pairs.hanzi:
伊文走过来，先问他刚才那一行数是不是抄错，自己把早停和午后停混在了一起。
他指给伊文看，后者改完，长长出了一口气，说原来自己也得带两张纸才装得下。

pairs.target: yuè qín shōu hǎo xiǎobāo , jīngguò tāmen shí wèn chīfàn de shì shuí guǎn . yīwén shuō zìjǐ qù wèn fùqīn , tā biàn jiāng liǎng rén yìqǐ wǎng ménwài tuī , shuō wèn dāngrán yào wèn , tuǐ yě kěyǐ xiān wǎng fàntīng zǒu .
pairs.english: Yueqin gathered her bag and asked who arranged lunch as she passed. Iven said he would ask his father; she steered them both toward the door, saying they could ask while their legs headed for the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 月芹收好小包，经过他们时问吃饭的事谁管。伊文说自己去问父亲，她便将两人一起往门外推，说问当然要问，腿也可以先往饭厅走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe gēnshàng . zǒu dào láng kǒu , tā kànjiàn yīwén shǒu cè nà dào mò hái zài , yǐjīng cóng hēi cèng chéng le huī , biàn bǎ zìjǐ yīxiù fānguòlái , zhǎo le yíkuài méi bǔdīng de dìfāng gěi tā .
pairs.english: Tavi followed laughing. At the corridor entrance he saw Iven’s ink stain still there, rubbed from black to grey, and turned his sleeve over to offer him an unpatched spot.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着跟上。走到廊口，他看见伊文手侧那道墨还在，已经从黑蹭成了灰，便把自己衣袖翻过来，找了一块没补丁的地方给他。
